title: land says a worker's work rows are late, not missing, while a distill is taking its session
goal: When a landing finds no work rows of the item while a distill holds the lock of a spool land reads (the worker's session-end distill has taken its spool file and not yet delivered the sidecar), bl_land.ops_work_rows prints a 'land:' line that its rows are late and names the distill in flight, not 'warning: ... missing'

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA'] = T
os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'] = os.getcwd()
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import ql_base, bl_land
q = os.path.join(T, 'querylog')
os.makedirs(os.path.join(q, 'spool'))
lock = ql_base.acquire(q)
try:
    assert lock is not None, 'could not plant a held distill lock'
    out = bl_land.ops_work_rows('.', 'ST-wg27eqbp')
finally:
    if lock is not None:
        ql_base.release(lock)
    shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert out and out[0].startswith('land:') and 'late' in out[0] and 'distill' in out[0], ('a landing while distill holds the lock warns of missing rows instead of saying they are late', out)

clauses.clause: When a landing finds no work rows of the item while a distill holds the lock of a spool land reads (the worker's session-end distill has taken its spool file and not yet delivered the sidecar), bl_land.ops_work_rows prints a 'land:' line that its rows are late and names the distill in flight, not 'warning: ... missing'

notes: From the retrospective of SP-3qowbedb; the operator accepted it at the close.
